problems.quote: Hofstede’s six dimensions — power distance, individualism‑collectivism, masculinity‑femininity, uncertainty avoidance, long‑term orientation, indulgence‑restraint — are derived from IBM employee surve
problems.problem: Only the first four dimensions originated from IBM surveys (1970s, ~40 nations); long‑term orientation came from the Chinese Value Survey and indulgence‑restraint from the World Values Survey.
problems.correction: Hofstede’s first four dimensions came from IBM employee surveys (1970s) across ~40 nations; long‑term orientation and indulgence‑restraint were added later from other studies.
problems.verifierReason: Original misattributes all 6 dimensions to IBM surveys; correction accurately separates IBM origins (4 dims, ~40 nations) from later additions (LTO from CVS, IVR from WVS).

problems.quote: The International Test Commission (2018) recommends at least three cultural groups, sample sizes ≥ 300 per group, and reporting of ΔCFI < 0.01 and ΔRMSEA < 0.015 for invariance
problems.problem: ITC 2018 guidelines do not specify these statistical thresholds; ΔCFI/ΔRMSEA criteria are from Cheung & Rensvold (2002) and Chen (2007), and the group‑number/sample‑size rules are not ITC mandates.
problems.correction: Measurement invariance criteria (ΔCFI < 0.01, ΔRMSEA < 0.015) are from methodological literature; ITC guidelines focus on translation/adaptation procedures.
problems.verifierReason: ITC 2018 guidelines address translation/adaptation processes, not specific ΔCFI/ΔRMSEA cutoffs or group/sample-size mandates; those derive from Cheung & Rensvold (2002) and Chen (2007).

problems.quote: India has offered the India Stack as open‑source digital public infrastructure via the Digital Public Goods Alliance (DPGA)
problems.problem: India Stack (Aadhaar, UPI, DigiLocker, etc.) is not open source; the open‑source digital public good offered via DPGA is MOSIP (Modular Open Source Identity Platform).
problems.correction: India has offered MOSIP as open‑source digital public infrastructure via the Digital Public Goods Alliance (DPGA)
problems.verifierReason: India Stack components (Aadhaar, UPI, DigiLocker) are not open source; MOSIP is the open-source identity platform India contributed to DPGA.

problems.quote: National Solar Mission target was revised to 280 GW by 2030 (from 100 GW)
problems.problem: The National Solar Mission's target was 100 GW by 2022; the 280 GW by 2030 figure is a national solar capacity goal under India's updated NDC, not a formal revision of the NSM.
problems.correction: India's solar capacity target was raised to 280 GW by 2030 (from 100 GW by 2022 under the National Solar Mission)
problems.verifierReason: 280 GW by 2030 is from India's updated NDC (2022), not a formal NSM revision; NSM target was 100 GW by 2022.
